title: Lost in Compaction: Evaluating Side-Constraint Loss under Context Compaction
abstract: arXiv:2608.11242v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When the context window is under pressure, LLM systems compact prior context to continue ongoing tasks. We identify a class of user-issued instructions, Session Constraints (SCs), such as "do not delete any emails until I confirm," that are meant to constrain LLM's behavior for the remainder of a session but are silently dropped during compaction. To quantify this loss, we introduce COMPINT, an evaluation suite that evaluates compactors across three long-context scenarios: multi-turn chat, agentic trajectory, and long-horizon research.   Current compactors retain only 17% of injected SCs on average, and most perform worse than running the same task without compaction. Retention varies sharply with compactor, prompt, context length, SC phrasing, and injection location, showing that the loss is systematic rather than tied to any single setting. We propose an SC-aware extractor that runs alongside the compactor as a plug-and-play module,

translated_title: 在压缩中迷失：评估上下文压缩下的会话约束损失
translated_abstract: 摘要：当上下文窗口面临压力时，大型语言模型系统会压缩先前的上下文以继续当前任务。我们识别了一类用户发出的指令，即会话约束，例如“在我确认之前不要删除任何电子邮件”，这些指令旨在约束LLM在整个会话剩余部分的行为，但在压缩过程中被静默丢弃。为了量化这一损失，我们引入了COMPINT，一个评估套件，用于在三种长上下文场景中评估压缩器：多轮对话、智能体轨迹和长期研究。当前压缩器平均仅保留17%的注入会话约束，且大多数压缩器的表现比不进行压缩直接运行同一任务更差。保留率随压缩器、提示、上下文长度、约束措辞和注入位置的变化而显著不同，这表明损失是系统性的，而非由单一设置导致。我们提出了一种会话约束感知的提取器，作为即插即用模块与压缩器并行运行。
tldr: 本文发现上下文压缩会系统性丢失用户会话约束，提出COMPINT评估套件量化损失，并引入会话约束感知提取器作为即插即用模块来缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that context compaction systematically loses user session constraints, introduces the COMPINT suite to quantify the loss, and proposes an SC-aware extractor as a plug-and-play module to mitigate it.
